logline: As the light fades both warriors descend onto opposite sides of the ruined platform, exhausted, weapons glowing faintly; a close-up of their eyes, a sudden rush toward each other, and a brilliant white flash.
styleReference: Premium cinematic anime: dramatic cel shading, atmospheric perspective over clouds, rich red-gold contrast, impact frames, speed ramps. No narration, no subtitles, no logos.
